subject.title: fix: native landing accepts validation-empty draft CI

question: Should maintainers sponsor an immediate protected-label fix for the native landing gate so hosted prepare rejects draft/validation-empty CI and merge-run revalidates exact-head CI before merge?
rationale: The bug is source-backed and has two live examples, but the protected `maintainer` label means automation should not close or independently queue the repair.

options.title: Sponsor the gate fix now
options.body: Patch the hosted verifier and merge verifier with regression tests for draft-skipped preflight and ready-for-review rerun pending or failed states.

options.title: Keep open for manual scheduling
options.body: Leave the issue open without automation and let maintainers decide when the landing workflow work fits the release queue.

options.title: Accept current risk temporarily
options.body: Document that maintainers must avoid draft-run prepare artifacts until a later workflow-hardening change lands.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the gate fix now
recommendation.body: Patch the hosted verifier and merge verifier with regression tests for draft-skipped preflight and ready-for-review rerun pending or failed states.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent hosted-gate PR history and this issue's evidence point to steipete as the closest routing owner for the protected landing workflow decision.
